note: Municipal elections, 21 May 1952. Castle Ward was the only contest printed. After withdrawals Castle Ward was the only contest (North Down Herald, 10 May 1952, p. 1). Aldermen for Ballyholme, Castle and Dufferin wards and the councillors of Ballyholme, Clifton and Dufferin wards were returned unopposed (Herald and News-Letter nominations reports); Princetown's retiring members were returned unopposed but are not named in the sources searched (round 2, 7 Nov 2026). The Herald prints the surname only; initials as in the 1946 and 1958 returns of the same aldermanship (C. A. Valentine). Returned unopposed.
